title: Package-hash mapping (input of the run-sheet generator)
description: Expected package hash per Study A book or Study B dyad slot of one study and set, used to pre-fill the run-sheet hash_check column. Produced from the package builder's manifests (#13). Keys: Study A book IDs from the learner-facing slot list (BK-<P|C>-XXXXXX), Study B dyad slot IDs (B-C01, spares B-S01). Values: package SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex digits. placeholder=true marks DEMO placeholder values (allowed only with demo=true); run sheets then show DEMO-placeholder:<hex>, which never matches a real package. See docs/interfaces/schedules.md.
